title: LRU cache
hints: Pattern: LRU cache. The invariant is "entries are stored in usage order, oldest first"; every get and put must keep that true.
collections.OrderedDict has move_to_end(key) to mark a key as most recently used and popitem(last=False) to remove the oldest.
get: if the key is missing return None; otherwise move_to_end and return the value. put: assign, move_to_end, then evict the oldest if the length exceeds the capacity.
Assign first and evict after the length check, so updating an existing key never triggers an eviction.
